We need to answer with the winner. That would be the album and artist? In 2017 Grammys, which year? But maybe they refer to the award ceremony held in 2017 awarding albums from previous year. So we should provide the winner: "Best Album – Record of the Year"? - Kendrick Lamar – To Pimp A Butterfly
- Kanye West & Jay-Z – Watch the Throne
